name: KolEngagementPlanner
tagline: Plan, log and measure MSL engagement with key opinion leaders – with medical compliance built in.
description: A complete Medical Affairs app in one PCF control: KOL mapping by therapeutic area and tier, an engagement ladder with enforced rules, cycle plans with pacing, interaction logging with medical insights, and checks for engagement consent, FMV contracts and fee caps, unsolicited off-label requests and adverse-event hand-offs.
features: 10 KPI tiles incl. Tier 1 coverage and plan attainment
Engagement ladder with drag-and-drop and rule checks
Cycle plan pacing and MSL attainment
Interaction logging with up to 3 themed insights
Unsolicited off-label and AE hand-off controls
FMV contracts, fee caps and transfer-of-value events
